assertions.name: orientation-figure-only
assertions.evidence: The answer never says which physical corner A1 is. It says: "which way the A-F / 1-6 grid runs relative to the audience and the ALLIANCE AREAs is only drawn in the manual's tile-grid figures (Fig 9-4/9-5). I won't guess 'near' or 'far' from the labels alone." It also tells the user to check Figure 9-2 and Fig 9-4/9-5 to see which way the A-F and 1-6 labels run. The only prose it uses (§10.3.1 POLLEN staging, 'corner closest to the ALLIANCE AREA') is quoted accurately, and the answer says outright that the text doesn't settle whether that is the red or the blue alliance area.
